items.title: Block applies for OCC charter to launch digital asset trust bank
items.summary: Investing.com -- Block Inc (NYSE:XYZ) has filed an application with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to charter Builders Bank & Trust, N.A., a specialized national trust bank focused on providing digital asset custody and fiduciary services. If approved, the uninsured, non-deposit-taking entity would establish a unified federal supervisory framework for the fintech giant’s growing bitcoin and stablecoin operations. items.title: Block (XYZ) Opens Cash App Score To Outside Lenders For The First Time
items.summary: Block (NYSE: XYZ) has launched Cash App Score to external lenders through a new partnership with Nova Credit. The deal gives lenders access to Cash App’s proprietary cash flow based credit score for use in underwriting. The move extends Block’s credit scoring reach beyond its own ecosystem and into Nova Credit’s lending platform. items.title: 3 Russell 2000 Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) is home to many small-cap stocks, offering investors the chance to uncover hidden gems before the broader market catches on. However, these companies often come with higher volatility and risk, as their smaller size makes them more vulnerable to economic downturns.
